scope: volatile staging and authenticated verification only; no storage mutation
progress: In-order chunks, identical prior chunk retries accepted; conflicting or out-of-order chunks fail the transfer. Transfer IDs increase per boot. USB disconnect, timeout or worker safety failure invalidates the candidate; no success is published after cancellation.
signature: P-256 ECDSA SHA-256, raw r[32] || s[32]
proof_encoding: ASCII domain and fields, each followed by LF; lower-case hex and UUID, canonical unsigned decimal integers
challenge: fresh independently random nonzero 32-byte host nonce, never derived from the credential
credential_digest: SHA-256 of the exact original complete signed envelope; distinct from the signed-content ID
trust: Verify the original factory signature against configured issuer and device-owned identity. Verify this separate result signature against the selected device's independently recorded public key.
replay: Bind selected role, device, hardware, source, boot, monotonic nonzero transfer ID, fresh challenge, both hashes and credential revision; discard on disconnect or deadline.
limits: A valid result proves a device signed this verification outcome, not installation, durable storage, ownership or command authorization. Runtime resource and device behavior require separate qualification.
